Leah (Finance): Heads-up from partner Meridian: they noticed a $2,400 credit and a reversal back-to-back on their June invoice, want us to review.
Ravi (Acct Manager): I pulled INV-2026-4022. Lines show PROMO-JUNE-2026 credit $2,400 and then REV-PROMO -$2,400 the next day. Customer says they only qualified once.
Omar (Billing Ops): Checking the promo backfill controller. We had a scheduled run that coincided with a controller failover; looks like the backfill retried and re-applied credits without checking idempotency. Logs:
```
2026-06-05T05:02:10Z promo-backfill run=pb-20260605 acct=mer-701 apply_credit promo=PROMO-JUNE-2026 amt=2400 token=tok-9f attempts=1
2026-06-05T05:02:10Z promo-backfill run=pb-20260605 acct=mer-701 apply_credit promo=PROMO-JUNE-2026 amt=2400 token=tok-9f attempts=2
```
Ravi (Acct Manager): So duplicate credit applied then automated reconciliation detected a mismatch and reversed one. Customer sees both lines and is worried.
Leah (Finance): Policy: reverse accidental duplicate promo credits. Post reversal of $2,400 with code REV-PROMO and notify the customer. Add postmortem card for backfill idempotency. Tag rc=promo-backfill-failover.
Omar (Billing Ops): Queuing reversal: `vb adjust-reversal --acct mer-701 --amount 2400 --currency USD --invoice INV-2026-4022 --code REV-PROMO --note "duplicate promo from backfill retry"`
rebill-bot: Action queued: reversal_pending | id=BILL-14567 | acct=mer-701 | amt=2400 USD
Omar (Billing Ops): Reversal posted txn=RV-2026-D4B7. Added rc tag promo-backfill-failover.
Ravi (Acct Manager): Sent message to Meridian: "Hi  we found a duplicate promo credit applied in error due to a backfill retry. We've posted a reversal of $2,400 (txn RV-2026-D4B7). This will appear as a reversal line on your next statement; it does not create an immediate charge. We're making the backfill idempotent to prevent this.    "
Leah (Finance): Thanks. Please add mitigation: include idempotency tokens and leader election backoff for backfill controller. Close when ledger reconciles.
